location.en: Bayside Pharmacy, near the language school
location.zh: 語言學校附近的灣畔藥局

goal.en: Get something for your headache and learn how to take it.
goal.zh: 買到頭痛藥，並問清楚怎麼服用。

background: small neighborhood pharmacy with white shelves of plain unmarked boxes, a clean consultation counter, a small potted plant, glass front door, bright clean lighting, afternoon

intro.en: You stayed up late watching videos, and now your head is pounding.
intro.zh: 你熬夜看影片，現在頭痛得要命。

intro.en: Mia pats you on the back and sends you to the pharmacy on the corner.
intro.zh: 米亞同情地拍拍你的背，叫你去轉角的藥局。

lines.en: Hello. What seems to be the problem today?

choices.tip: I have a + 症狀，是描述身體不舒服的基本句型。

choices.en: Hi. My head is very pain.

lines.en: Your head is...? Did you hit your head? Did you fall?
lines.zh: 你的頭……？你撞到頭了嗎？是跌倒了嗎？

story.en: She thinks you hurt your head and sends you to the walk-in clinic. You spend the whole afternoon in a waiting room for a simple headache.
story.zh: 藥師以為你撞傷了頭，請你去診所檢查。你為了一個小頭痛，在候診室坐了一整個下午。

fail.why: pain 是名詞，不能說 My head is very pain.。頭痛直接說 I have a headache.，也可以說 My head hurts.。

lines.en: You're fine? Then... how can I help you?
lines.zh: 你很好？那……我能幫你什麼？

story.en: Flustered, you point at the nearest shelf. You walk out with a big bottle of vitamins and the same headache.
story.zh: 你一慌，隨手指了最近的貨架。結果你帶著一大罐維他命和原本的頭痛走出藥局。

fail.why: What seems to be the problem? 是在問「哪裡不舒服？」，不是問你有沒有問題。直接說症狀：I have a headache.。

lines.en: I see. These tablets work well for headaches. Any questions?
lines.zh: 了解。這種藥錠治頭痛很有效。有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: Yes. How often should I take them?
choices.tip: How often 問頻率；「吃藥」英文要用 take，不是 eat。

choices.en: Yes. How many times should I eat them?

lines.en: Eat them? Oh, no, you don't chew these. You swallow them with water.
lines.zh: 吃？喔，不，這不是用嚼的，要配水吞下去。

story.en: You get a five-minute lesson on swallowing pills. You leave knowing exactly how to take one, but not how often.
story.zh: 你上了五分鐘的吞藥教學。走出藥局時，你很清楚怎麼吞，卻不知道該多久吃一次。

fail.why: 中文說「吃藥」，英文要說 take medicine，說 eat 聽起來像在嚼糖果。問頻率用 How often should I take them?。

choices.en: Yes. How much times I take a day?

lines.en: How much? Oh, they're eight dollars.

story.en: You pay, nod and leave. At home, you realize you have no idea how many to take.
story.zh: 你付了錢、點了頭就走了。回到家才發現，你根本不知道一天要吃幾顆。

fail.why: times 是可數名詞，要用 many，問句也少了助動詞。問服藥頻率最自然的說法是 How often should I take them?；How much 開頭常被當成在問價錢。

lines.en: One tablet every six hours, with food. Anything else you'd like to know?
lines.zh: 每六小時一顆，飯後吃。還有什麼想知道的嗎？

choices.tip: side effects 是「副作用」，買藥時問一句，用起來更安心。

choices.en: Does it has any side effects?

lines.en: Does it... has? Sorry, I didn't catch that.

story.en: Too shy to repeat it, you say "Never mind." That night, the tablets make you so sleepy that you fall asleep on your homework.
story.zh: 你不好意思再說一次，只好說「沒事」。當天晚上，藥效讓你昏昏欲睡，直接趴在作業上睡著了。

fail.why: does 後面的動詞要用原形：Does it have any side effects?。更常見的問法是 Are there any side effects?。

choices.en: Is this safe? You sure? Really?
choices.zh: 這安全嗎？你確定？真的嗎？

lines.en: Yes, I'm sure. I am a pharmacist.

story.en: She answers politely but coldly. The helpful tips she was about to give you about rest and water? You don't get any.
story.zh: 她回答得很客氣，但語氣冷淡。本來要給你的休息、喝水小建議，一個都沒說。

fail.why: 連續追問 You sure? Really? 聽起來像在質疑對方的專業。想了解風險，客氣地問 Are there any side effects? 就好。

lines.en: They might make you a little sleepy. So, no more late-night videos!
lines.zh: 可能會讓你有點想睡。所以，不准再熬夜看影片了！

lines.en: You laugh, a little guiltily. One tablet and one long nap later, your headache is gone.
lines.zh: 你心虛地笑了笑。吃了一顆藥、睡了一場長長的午覺，頭痛就不見了。

story.en: You got the right medicine and know exactly how to take it. Mia makes you promise to go to bed earlier.
story.zh: 你買對了藥，也清楚知道怎麼吃。米亞還要你保證以後早點睡。

notes.explain: 描述症狀用 I have a + 症狀。身體部位加 -ache 就是「……痛」，例如 stomachache（胃痛）、toothache（牙痛）。

example.en: I have a stomachache and a slight fever.

notes.en: How often should I take it?
notes.explain: How often 問頻率，常見的回答有 every six hours（每六小時）、twice a day（一天兩次）。

example.en: How often should I take it? Twice a day, after meals.
example.zh: 我應該多久吃一次？一天兩次，飯後吃。

notes.explain: 買藥時值得問的問題。常見副作用有 drowsiness（嗜睡）、upset stomach（腸胃不適）。

example.en: Are there any side effects? It may make you drowsy.
example.zh: 有副作用嗎？可能會讓你想睡。

notes.explain: 英文的「吃藥」用 take，eat 只用在食物。take a pill、take medicine 都是正確說法。

example.en: Don't forget to take your medicine after dinner.

notes.explain: 在很多英語國家，小病小痛會先到藥局問藥師，不一定要看醫生。藥師很樂意回答問題，有疑問儘管問。

example.en: Can you recommend something for a sore throat?
example.zh: 可以推薦治喉嚨痛的藥嗎？
